finding: ConversationTree.Clone passed its explicit null head to FromEntries, which interprets null as the final entry. A canonical snapshot therefore restored history after the user selected the empty branch. Clone now copies entries then explicitly selects the original head, including null.

upstreamEvidence.comparison: The source share oracle exports only header and pi.share for a retained-history null selection; the old native snapshot exported the previous branch. Initial comparison retained this mismatch without normalization.

verification.scope: Combined worktree includes the separately recorded share and schema implementation.

limitations: This fixes explicit null snapshots/clones; complete session branching, recovery and persistence parity remain ledgered.
